findings.title: Current no-change receipt omits four selected UI form principles
findings.detail: The draft requires completed rendering, frontend and backend validation, validation for disabled fields, and central rule maintenance. Its current receipt has zero outputs. The review rejects these rules because no workflow or schema is named. The source explicitly names RATAN UI forms. Current canonical searches found no corresponding rules or source citation.
findings.consequence: Retrieval from canonical knowledge loses qualified draft intent despite accepted source processing.
findings.next_action: During authorized conversion, review these four clauses as draft intent. Preserve unresolved applicability and human publication review.
findings.confidence: high for omission; current approved applicability remains unknown
findings.blocking_disposition: Diagnostic finding; no production failure or release hold established.

findings.title: Notification draft loses connection and entitlement rules behind an approval prerequisite
findings.detail: Selected lines 27-30 require cluster reconnection, blocking connection errors, a JWT header, and backend entitlement filtering. The accepted zero-output review requires accepted security policy before recording these draft claims. Other HTTP-header claims do not preserve the notification context.
findings.consequence: A later approval requirement incorrectly prevents earlier qualified capture of selected intent. Canonical retrieval misses notification-specific conditions.
findings.next_action: During authorized conversion, retain the source-scoped draft rules. Keep approval, current applicability, and publication unresolved.
findings.blocking_disposition: No deployed notification defect is established.

findings.title: Roadmap selection relies on current approval rather than mixed-source intent
findings.detail: The 2025 Target page mixes milestones with capability targets and a pre-rule migration responsibility. Its EVIDENCE_ONLY rationale cites historical planning and absent current approval. The policy preserves historical and proposed intent. Complete cross-source coverage of these goals was not assessed.
findings.consequence: The full-page disposition can omit proposed capabilities from intent review. Global canonical loss remains unproved.
findings.next_action: Review the mixed page by section. Retain only supported historical or proposed intent with explicit scope.
findings.confidence: medium; full cross-source semantic coverage remains unchecked

findings.title: Completed bulk-processing summary omits exact preview field inventories
findings.detail: Original lines 21 and 30 enumerate preview fields. WF-CF-048 retains only cashflow details and affirmation data. Value Date and Payment Date conflicts remain visible elsewhere.
findings.consequence: Canonical-only retrieval cannot reconstruct the exact preview contract. The original citation remains available.
findings.next_action: Assess whether downstream knowledge queries need the explicit field contract. Preserve source-specific names if added.
findings.confidence: high for compression; product impact unknown

sample_method.method: Purposive stratified diagnostic sample. Select current accepted, queued, dependency-reopened, KEEP, KEEP_SECTIONS, EXCLUDE, EVIDENCE_ONLY, and HOLD strata across all four collections. Extend zero-output receipt stratum after finding loss risk. Read complete originals, selected ranges and relevant canonical sections. This is not a random sample.
sample_method.conclusion: Two sampled current zero-output receipts omit qualified draft intent. One roadmap selection needs renewed semantic review. Other sampled mappings preserve stated conditions or expose explicit limits. No sample-wide or collection-wide semantic percentage is inferred.
scope_limits: Selected canonical sections were read for the named source claims; unrelated records were searched only for specific missing clauses.
Sampled omission is not production impact or proof of current approved behavior.
Missing external attachments were not fetched.
Prior actual reviews were not blindly adopted as current semantic proof. Source sample meanings were reread.
